events.text: How much is delivery?

events.query: How much is delivery?

events.text:
Hello! We offer several delivery options depending on where you're sending your order. Within the UK, Standard delivery costs £3.95 (or is free on orders over £40), while Express delivery is £7.95 [KB-101].

For large items, there is a £29 charge for two-person courier service. If you are ordering outside the UK, international standard delivery costs £9.95 [KB-101, KB-113].
Do you do next day delivery?

events.query: Do you do next day delivery?

events.text: We do offer Express delivery, which takes 1 to 2 working days and costs £7.95. You can order before 2pm for dispatch on the same working day. You can find more details on our delivery options in the help centre [KB-101].
If I order express at 3pm today will it go out today?

events.query: If I order express at 3pm today will it go out today?

events.text: Hello! According to our delivery information, you need to order before 2 pm to ensure your order is dispatched the same working day [KB-101]. Since you are ordering at 3 pm, it won't go out today, but we can still help you check the delivery times for your items.
Is delivery free?

events.query: Is delivery free?

events.text: Standard delivery is free on orders over £40, but Standard delivery generally costs £3.95, and Express delivery costs £7.95. Large items, such as furniture, cost £29 to send [KB-101].
How long does a sofa take to arrive?

events.query: How long does a sofa take to arrive?

events.text: Sofas are considered large items, which are delivered by a two-person courier service. Our help centre states that these large items typically take between 5 and 10 working days to arrive, and the cost is £29 [KB-101].
Do you ship to Italy?

events.query: Do you ship to Italy?

events.text: I am sorry, but I don't have information regarding international shipping destinations like Italy in my help-centre articles. Would you like me to pass you to a person from customer care who can check this for you?
Can I get express delivery to Dublin?

events.query: Can I get express delivery to Dublin?

events.text: I'm afraid that Express delivery is not available outside of the UK. For international standard delivery to Ireland, you can expect your order to arrive within 5 to 8 working days [KB-113]. Please let me know if you have any other questions about international delivery!
Will I have to pay customs on an order to France?

events.query: Will I have to pay customs on an order to France?

events.text: For orders to France, you won't need to pay customs or duties extra when the delivery arrives. The good news is that import taxes and duties are included in the price when you place your order to the EU, so there's nothing extra to pay on delivery [KB-113].
Do you deliver to the US?

events.query: Do you deliver to the US?

events.text: Based on our help-centre articles, we currently deliver to Ireland, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Spain, but we do not deliver to the US [KB-113]. Is there anything else I can help you with regarding our other policies?
How long do I have to return something?

events.query: How long do I have to return something?

events.text: You have 30 days from the date of delivery to return most items for a refund, provided they are unused and in their original packaging [KB-104]. If you need to start a return, you can do this through 'My orders' on the website. Do let me know if you have any other questions!
How do I return a rug?

events.query: How do I return a rug?

events.text: You can return most items, including a rug, within 30 days of delivery, provided it's unused and still in its original packaging [KB-104]. To start a return, please go to 'My orders' and follow the steps to select the item and choose 'Return' [KB-104]. If the rug is large, you will need to book a collection from there [KB-104].
Is it free to return something from Ireland?

events.query: Is it free to return something from Ireland?

events.text: I understand you're checking on return costs. Unfortunately, returns from Ireland are not free; there will be a charge of £6.95, which will be deducted from your refund [KB-104]. For UK addresses, however, returns are free.
Can I return a pillow I've opened?

events.query: Can I return a pillow I've opened?

events.text:
Unfortunately, due to hygiene and safety reasons, we are unable to accept returns for pillows, duvets, or mattress toppers once they have been taken out of their sealed packaging [KB-109].

If you have any questions about other items, please let me know!
I bought a personalised bowl, can I send it back?

events.query: I bought a personalised bowl, can I send it back?

events.text: I'm sorry, but we are unable to accept returns for personalised items, including your bowl. [KB-109] states that for hygiene and safety reasons, personalised or engraved items cannot be taken back.
Can I return a cushion that was final sale? I just don't like the colour.

events.query: Can I return a cushion that was final sale? I just don't like the colour.

events.text: I'm sorry, but unfortunately, items marked as 'Final sale' cannot be returned to us, regardless of the reason [KB-109]. This policy is in place for safety and hygiene reasons. Please do note that this restriction does not affect your rights if the item turns out to be damaged or faulty.
How long does a refund take?

events.query: How long does a refund take?

events.text: Once a refund is issued, it typically takes 5 to 10 working days to show up in your account, depending on your specific bank [KB-105]. This timeframe applies whether the refund is for a return or for damaged, faulty, or lost items. Let me know if you have any other questions about your order!
When will I get my money back?

events.query: When will I get my money back?

events.text:
To get a refund, you can return most items within 30 days of delivery [KB-104]. To start this, you would need to go to 'My orders' and select 'Return' to receive a prepaid label.

However, the articles don't specify the exact timeframe for when the refund money will actually be received. Would you like me to pass you to a person who can look into the timeline of your refund for you?
Do you refund the delivery cost if I send something back?

events.query: Do you refund the delivery cost if I send something back?

events.text: I don't have specific information about whether delivery costs are refunded when you send an item back. I recommend passing you to a member of our customer care team, as they can provide you with the most accurate details on our return refund process. Would you like me to connect you with them?
Can I pay with Klarna?

events.query: Can I pay with Klarna?

events.text: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Hollow Lane gift cards [KB-110]. I'm afraid Klarna is not one of the payment methods we currently accept. Please let me know if you have any questions about these options, and I'll be happy to help!
Do you take PayPal?

events.query: Do you take PayPal?

events.text: Yes, we do accept PayPal for payments when you place your order. We also take Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Apple Pay, and Hollow Lane gift cards. You can find more information about our accepted payments in our help centre [KB-110].
My payment failed, what do I do?

events.query: My payment failed, what do I do?

events.text: If your payment fails, please remember that your order won't be placed until the payment goes through. You should check your card details or try using a different payment method for your purchase [KB-110].
Can I add a discount code to my order? I forgot to use it.

events.query: Can I add a discount code to my order? I forgot to use it.

events.text: I'm afraid that promotion codes must be entered during the checkout process and cannot be added to an order once it has already been placed [KB-114]. You can only use one code per order, so please make sure to enter it before completing your purchase!
Can I use two promo codes on one order?

events.query: Can I use two promo codes on one order?

events.text: Hello! Unfortunately, you can only use one promotion code per order. These codes must be entered at checkout, and the policy states that only one can be used per order [KB-114].
The thing I bought last week is now on sale, can I get the difference back?

events.query: The thing I bought last week is now on sale, can I get the difference back?

events.text: I'm sorry, but we are unable to refund the difference if an item goes on sale after your order has been placed. According to our help centre, if an item you purchased goes on sale within 7 days of your order, we don't refund the difference [KB-114].
Do you price match John Lewis?

events.query: Do you price match John Lewis?

events.text: We do not offer price matching with other retailers, so we are unable to match prices from John Lewis or any other store [KB-114]. We hope this information helps with your purchase! Let me know if you have any other questions about our policies.
Do your prices include VAT?

events.query: Do your prices include VAT?

events.text: Yes, all prices shown on the Hollow Lane website include VAT [KB-114]. Let me know if you have any other questions about our policies!
How long are gift cards valid for?

events.query: How long are gift cards valid for?

events.text: Hollow Lane gift cards are valid for 24 months from the date of purchase and can be used on any order. Please remember that if you return an item paid for with a gift card, the refund will be issued as a new gift card. You can find more information in our help centre article [KB-111].
I lost my gift card, can you replace it?

events.query: I lost my gift card, can you replace it?

events.text: I understand you've lost your gift card, and I'm sorry to hear that. According to our help centre, lost gift cards can only be replaced if you have the original purchase receipt [KB-111]. Please let me know if you have that handy!
Can I swap a gift card for cash?

events.query: Can I swap a gift card for cash?

events.text: Hello! Unfortunately, gift cards can't be exchanged for cash or refunded [KB-111]. If you return an item you paid for with a gift card, the refund will be issued back to you as a new gift card.
What are your customer service hours?

events.query: What are your customer service hours?

events.text: Our customer care team is available from Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm UK time, and also on Saturday from 10am to 4pm [KB-112]. If we're closed, we will reply to your email by the end of the next working day. Let me know if you need help with anything else!
How do I track my order?

events.query: How do I track my order?

events.text: You can track your order by looking out for a tracking link via email once it has been dispatched. You can also check the status of your order in your Hollow Lane account under 'My orders' [KB-102]. This will show you if it is processing, dispatched, or delivered.
My parcel says delivered but it's not here

events.query: My parcel says delivered but it's not here

events.text:
I'm sorry to hear your parcel hasn't arrived; that's incredibly frustrating. According to our help centre, if your tracking says it's delivered but you can't locate it, please check with neighbours or any safe place you gave the courier [KB-103]. It's also helpful to wait one more working day, as couriers sometimes mark parcels as delivered early [KB-103].

If you still can't find it, please provide your order number so we can investigate this further for you.
Can I change my delivery address?

events.query: Can I change my delivery address?

events.text: You can change your delivery address if your order is still marked as 'Processing' by using the 'Change address' option in My orders [KB-108]. However, please be aware that once an order has been dispatched, we are unable to change it ourselves. For security, we cannot change the address over chat or phone, so you must follow the steps within your account [KB-108].
How do I cancel an order?

events.query: How do I cancel an order?

events.text: You can cancel an order if its status is **Processing** by going to "My orders" and selecting "Cancel order" [KB-107]. However, once an order is **Dispatched**, it cannot be cancelled; instead, you will need to refuse the delivery or return it when it arrives [KB-107].
